title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 15
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 15: Azariah's prophecy to Asa, the covenant to seek Yahweh, and the removal of Maacah.

questions.text: On whom did the Spirit of God come at the start of this chapter?
questions.explanation: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

questions.text: What did Azariah say would happen if Asa and Judah forsook Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Azariah said, "If you forsake him, he will forsake you."

answers.text: He will still give them rest
He will send a new king
He will move his house to another city

questions.text: What did Azariah say about Asa's work if he was strong and did not let his hands be slack?
questions.explanation: He said, "Be strong, and don't let your hands be slack; for your work will be rewarded."

answers.text: It will be finished by his son
It will be destroyed by enemies

questions.text: What did Asa renew after taking courage?
questions.explanation: He put away the abominations and renewed Yahweh's altar that was before Yahweh's porch.

answers.text: The gates of the city of David

questions.text: From which tribes did people come to Asa out of Israel?
questions.explanation: Those who lived with them out of Ephraim, Manasseh and Simeon came to him when they saw Yahweh was with him.

questions.text: In which year of Asa's reign did the people gather together at Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: They gathered at Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of Asa's reign.

questions.text: What did the covenant say should happen to whoever would not seek Yahweh?
questions.explanation: They agreed that whoever would not seek Yahweh, small or great, man or woman, should be put to death.

answers.text: They should pay a fine of silver
They should be put to death
They should offer a sin offering

questions.text: Why did Asa remove Maacah his mother from being queen?
questions.explanation: He removed her because she had made an abominable image for an Asherah.

answers.text: She had plotted against the king
She had made an abominable image for an Asherah
She had married a foreign king
She had taken gold from the temple

questions.text: Where did Asa burn the image Maacah had made?
questions.explanation: Asa cut down her image, ground it into dust and burned it at the brook Kidron.

answers.text: At the gate of the temple

questions.text: Until which year of Asa's reign was there no more war?
questions.explanation: There was no more war to the thirty-fifth year of Asa's reign.
